overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that checking swings_this_quarter >= cap would block new swing trades, but it only blocks when the count has already reached or exceeded the cap, allowing one extra trade to execute before blocking.
why_it_breaks: With a cap of 2 and 1 swing exit already used, swings_this_quarter=1. The condition (1 >= 2) is false, so all three swing trades execute, incrementing the count to 4. The guard only activates when swings_this_quarter reaches 2, which happens after the second swing trade completes, allowing a third to slip through before blocking begins.
